subject.statement: Apple named John Ternus to succeed Tim Cook as chief executive in 2026.
disambiguators: to succeed Tim Cook as chief executive

summary: Verdict: TRUE at 97% confidence. Decisive facts: Apple's press release dated April 20, 2026 (captured August 19, 2026) states John Ternus will become CEO effective September 1, 2026; NBC News (April 20, 2026) confirms the announcement; Wikipedia indicates John Patrick Ternus has been CEO since September 1, 2026.

findings.statement: John Ternus's full name is John Patrick Ternus.
As of September 30, 2026, John Ternus holds the title Chief Executive Officer of Apple.
John Ternus's position prior to becoming CEO was Senior Vice President, Hardware Engineering.
Apple issued an official press release on April 20, 2026 announcing John Ternus as successor CEO effective September 1, 2026.
